home.heroTitle: Funa Ekifo Kyo Ekiragi ku Campus

home.featuresHeading: Bye wetaaga byonna, mu kifo kimu
home.featuresSubtitle: Tufuula okukayinza okwangu, okukuumye era okutali buzibu.
home.ctaTitle: Oyagala okufuna ekifo kyo ku campus?

hostels.heroSubtitle: Laba era olyoke oteeke ekisulo ky'omuyizi ky'oyagala
hostels.noResults: Tewali kisulo kirirabika kiri mu ngeri eyo.
hostels.noRoomsAvailable: Tewali kisenge kiriko ku kisulo kino.
hostels.termsIntro: Twesaba osome era okkirize embeera z'ebiragiro byaffe ffe nga tonnatandika okukayinza kisenge.
hostels.roomGuarantee: Obukakafu bw'Okukomawo: Bw'oba tosiima kisenge mu kusaba, oyinza okusaza obutayinza n'omulabirira alireka ensimbi zo.
hostels.datePlaceholder: Nyiga era li oba wandika (YYYY-MM-DD oba DD/MM/YYYY)
hostels.passportHelp: Tukusaba yambuuliirawo ekisenge kya passport ekijoji. Kino kiyamba omulabirira w'ekisulo ne admin okumanya gwe nga olaba.
hostels.momoStep1: 1. Tuma 50% ya UGX {{amount}} eri omulabirira wano.
hostels.momoStep2: 2. Wandika ennamba yo ne sente ze watuma.
hostels.momoStep3: 3. Admin alaba era alyoke akakase ettendo lyo — Transaction ID ligaanibwa mu kati.
hostels.sendToCaretaker: Tuma sente eri ennamba ya mulabirira wano
hostels.momoConfirmNote: Oli mu mwe mwatandika okutabiliza UGX {{amount}} ku va {{number}} {{phone}}. Ssensaze filimu ey'okusasula wagulaga. Admin alyoke akuubizze.
hostels.bankInstruction: Twangu okusasula ekitundu kyo ku akaawunti eyo, oluvannyuma lyoka osande Risiiti wo.
hostels.refundGuarantee: Obukakafu bw'Okukomawo: Twagala woneebaze. Bw'oba tosiima kisenge mu kusaba, oyinza okusaza obutayinza n'omulabirira alireka ensimbi zo.
hostels.term1: 50% ya deposit wo ekuuma ekisenge ko mu butirivu ne wandyoleka nga otegya kisenge.
hostels.term2: Obwenkanya obwo buva mu mulabirira w'ekisulo, si mu yunivasite.
hostels.term3: Gobera embeera z'ebisulo n'ebiragiro, era wangaanye ebintu by'ekisulo.
hostels.agreeTerms: Nnaama n'okkiriza Embeera n'Ebiragiro by'oli mu.
hostels.pleaseLoginRegister: Tukusaba weko lw'okutuuka emu nga nookola mu kisenge.
hostels.confirmSentMoney: Tukusaba kakasa nga watuma sente okusooka.
hostels.acceptTermsFirst: Tukusaba osome n'okkiriza Embeera n'Ebiragiro nga toonna okukayinza.
hostels.reservationSubmitted:
Okukayinza kwo kuweebwayo!

Omulabirira w'ekisulo ajja kukakasa ensimbi zo, era admin ajja kuzikakasa. Okuweebwayo kwa payment kunaakuka nga okakasiddwa.
hostels.reservationSuccess: Okukayinza kwo kukola! Ekisenge kyo kibeera kyaawo.
hostels.invalidMomoNumber: Wandika ennamba ya mobile money etatuukirira, e.g. 0772123456.

subscribe.subscribeTitle: Wandiika Mu Kifo Ky'okusasulira Ekisulo Kyo
subscribe.subscribeSubtitle: Sasula ebika ebyetaagisa okugezaako okuggulawo, okukuuma, n'okufuna ebibuuza mu kisulo kyo.
subscribe.canNowAdd: Oli mu ndawo okwongera era okulabirira ekisulo kyo.
subscribe.feeDescription: Ssente zino zisasulwa abalabirira/abanannyini ebisulo eri system admin (Dean of Students) okugaziwa, okukubiriza ebisulo, n'okufuna ebibuuza mu kisubirizo.
subscribe.momoInstruction: Tuma UGX {{amount}} eri ennamba ya admin mobile money wano, oluvannyuma wandika eby'okugenda.
subscribe.onlyCaretakers: Abalabirira bokka be beesasula okulamba ebisulo.
subscribe.subscriptionSubmitted:
Okwewaayo kwo kuweebwayo!

System admin ajja kuverefyeka okusasula kwo n'alyoke aktivaate okwewaayo kwo. Bwe kuba ng'aweesa, oliba omu kifo okwongera n'okulabirira ekisulo kyo.

caretakerRegister.termsIntro: Tukusaba osome era olyoke oskirize embeera zino ng'otandika okwongera ekisulo kyo.
caretakerRegister.listingDesc: Ekisulo kyo kija kulabika era ekyangu. Olina enaku 4 (eby'enaku ez'okulyoka kuyita) okusasula ssente. Bw'okyayagala obutassasula mu kaseera ako, ekisulo kyo gikende.
caretakerRegister.paymentDesc: Ssente z'okukayinza zisabibwa ku dda. Bw'aba owanyweza omuyizi nga tasazawa olw'obulwadde, watafu kwenyigidde ku kusasula ensimbi ze.
caretakerRegister.responsibilitiesDesc: Kuuma ebifa ku kisulo kyo ebituufu n'ebigenda mu maaso, nga bw'etondeka. Labirira eby'okukayinza n'okugoberera amateeka ga Bugema University.
caretakerRegister.agreeTerms: Nnaama n'okkiriza Embeera n'Ebiragiro by'oli mu.
caretakerRegister.createSubtitle: Kola akaawunti yawe ya mulabirira, ongere ekisulo kyo, osasule ssente — byonna mu kati.
caretakerRegister.step1: Teeka mu bwino eby'akaawunti yo, ekisulo n'ebintu ebya ssente.
caretakerRegister.step2: Ekisulo kyo kiryoke kilabike. Sasula ssente ze bilaga mu 4 dni.
caretakerRegister.step3: Bw'abeera nga admin asunsa okusasula kwo, okwewaayo kwo kuneebwe mu kifo.
caretakerRegister.momoInstruction: Tuma UGX {{price}} eri ennamba ya admin mobile money wano, oluvannyuma wandika eby'okugenda.
caretakerRegister.enterFullName: Tukusaba wandika erinnya lyo erya wamulezi.
caretakerRegister.enterValidPhone: Tukusaba wandika ennamba ya ssimu etukirira.
caretakerRegister.onboardSuccess: Akaawunti yo, ekisulo n'okwewaayo byaweebwayo. Okutandika, sisteemu admin ajja kukakasa okusasula kwo n'okutandika okuwandiika ekisulo kyo.
